posts.description: Watching the Hokies at Miami tonight was way more fun and less depressing than I expected. Shame to lose, but giving up one possession to two Heisman candidates who were favored by three touchdowns isn’t bad.
Watched: Zootopia 2 🍿 Simply spectacular. Seems no jokes were left on the cutting room floor; every frame is filled with references, commentary, in-jokes, visual gags, and joy.

Today I learned why there are two different ways to spell the tetanus/diphtheria/pertussis vaccine: Kids get DTaP, while adolescents and adults get Tdap. The uppercase and lowercase letters indicate the relative strength of the vaccine’s components. Wild.
